items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: He was way ahead of his time and he was just super drummer. In the beginning he was influenced by Baby Dodds.

ctx.x: Oh, no, what I was going to say was as much as you want to say about Dave, it's great, because there isn't anyone here to speak for Dave, and there are not so many people today who really knew him. Unquestionably he was a wonderful guy, so please state all you want.

So I can say this -- very good. Before I met Bix, before I ever knew Bix existed, Dave Tough told me about King Oliver and Louis. He was way ahead of his time and he was just super drummer. In the beginning he was influenced by Baby Dodds. Let's see, there was Johnny Dodds was the clarinet player and his brother was Baby. They were in the King Oliver band, and Dave was very much influenced, by him. Of course, MS. DANCE: George Wettling was too. MR. FREEMAN: Yes, Of course they were. I say this with all due…
I had ever heard, and of course, Sid Catlett and Dave were considered the tops of their times.
